text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest` because I have no shell here. I checked each fix by reading it against the tests, and all of them should now pass. Please run the suite to confirm.

- `catalog/search.py`: imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist (`catalog.nonexistent`); it now imports from `catalog.text`. This error stopped the search tests from loading at all.
- `catalog/books.py`: `parse_book` kept the year as text; it's now converted to a number, which also fixes `age()`.
- `catalog/fees.py`: the fee added the days and the daily rate together instead of multiplying them.
- `catalog/members.py`: the borrow limit was 3; the policy and tests say 5.
- `catalog/inventory.py`: `recent(n)` returned one event too many. I also made `recent(0)` return an empty list, which no test covers.
- `catalog/factory.py`: the sample data was missing the book "Emma".

I didn't change any tests.
